morphology.pattern_note: 按不可作马来语词缀拆分的专名整体处理。正文通常大写为 Shalimar；输入未确定具体所指、规范读音或爪夷文，因此保留相关空值。

senses.zh_definition: 沙利马尔：外来专名，可见于花园等名称；具体所指须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: A proper name occurring in names such as Shalimar Gardens; its referent depends on context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas yang digunakan, antaranya, dalam nama Taman Shalimar; rujukannya bergantung pada konteks.
senses.nuances: 这里的 noun 表示专有名词。输入没有提供可确认的马来语普通词义，故不标 official，也不把某一处花园认定为唯一所指。以下例句明确采用巴基斯坦拉合尔的花园作为示例。[UNESCO World Heritage Centre](https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/171/)

collocations.zh: 拉合尔的沙利马尔花园

dual_scenarios.en: The report discusses the conservation of Shalimar Gardens in Lahore, Pakistan.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Esok nak pergi Taman Shalimar kat Lahore tu tak?

etymology.historical_story: One documented bearer of the name is Lahore's Shalimar Gardens, constructed under Shah Jahan in 1641–1642. Its terraces, water features, and pavilions preserve an important Mughal garden tradition shaped by Persian influences. This is the history of a named place, not proof of the name's literal etymology or of a Malay common-noun meaning. [UNESCO World Heritage Centre](https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/171/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Shalimar 整体联想到“沙利马尔花园”的水池与亭阁；这是专名记忆图像，不是词源拆解或唯一所指。
